# Installation

automol requires Python 3.13 or later.
It is published as a conda package on [prefix.dev](https://prefix.dev/channels/avcopan/automech) and as a Python package on [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/automol/).

## With Pixi

In a [Pixi](https://pixi.sh) workspace, add the `avcopan/automech` channel and then automol:

```bash
pixi workspace channel add https://repo.prefix.dev/avcopan/automech
pixi add automol
```

RDKit (identity and InChI/SMILES conversions) and py3Dmol (interactive viewing) are installed with it.

:::{.callout-note}
xyzrender, which `geom.render_svg` and `geom.render_gif` use, is only on PyPI, so the conda package leaves it out.
To render images, add it as a PyPI dependency:

```bash
pixi add --pypi xyzrender
```

Everything else works without it, and the render functions raise an `ImportError` explaining this if it is missing.
:::

## With pip or uv

```bash
pip install automol   # or: uv add automol
```

This installs xyzrender too.

## For development

See [Contributing](https://github.com/avcopan/automol/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
